title: Functionally Graded Lattice Beam Qualification
objectives: Validate sequential yielding of programmed zones
Assess global stability of heterogeneous nonlinear structures

setup.boundaryConditions: Fixed at base, prescribed displacement at tip

programming.function: Linear ramp from 250 MPa (base) to 100 MPa (tip)

successCriteria.yieldProgression: Plasticity must initiate at the tip and propagate toward the base as load increases.
successCriteria.forceDisplacement: Global response must match integrated analytical predictions for a graded beam.
successCriteria.convergence: Newton-Raphson must maintain quadratic convergence during zone-by-zone yield transitions.
